# `@videojs/spf/features/airplay-fairplay`

Source: [src/playback/features/airplay-fairplay.ts](../../../src/playback/features/airplay-fairplay.ts)

## airPlayFairPlayFeature

Plays FairPlay-protected content on an AirPlay receiver, negotiating the receiver's keys while a session holds.

Requires the `drm` and `keySystems` config, such as `drmFeature` sets; without them it throws once a session starts.
Does nothing without a writer of `state.loadingSuspended`, such as `airPlayFeature`, which signals the session.

### Behaviors

1. [setupAirPlayFairPlay](../behaviors/dom/setup-airplay-fairplay.md#setupairplayfairplay)

(documented on [setupMediaKeys](../behaviors/dom/setup-media-keys.md#setupmediakeys)) |
| `keySystems` | `readonly KeySystemModule<string>[]` | — | [setupAirPlayFairPlay](../behaviors/dom/setup-airplay-fairplay.md#setupairplayfairplay) | The key systems this composition can negotiate, most-preferred first. **Required** — which systems an engine carries is a composition decision, and each module dropped from the list drops its own negotiation, init-data, and license-shaping code with it. (documented on [setupMediaKeys](../behaviors/dom/setup-media-keys.md#setupmediakeys)) |
